tools.name: get_artist_by_name
tools.description: Search for an artist or performer by name and return their upcoming shows at Zouk Group Las Vegas venues.

name.description: Artist name or partial name to search for.

tools.name: get_artist_details
tools.description: Get an artist's profile and their upcoming shows at Zouk Group venues.

performercode.description: URvenue performer code, e.g. "PER1223". Obtain codes from get_artists.

tools.name: get_artists
tools.description: List artists and performers who have upcoming events at Zouk Group Las Vegas venues.

venue.description: Filter by venue slug: zouk, ayu, moonbeam, redtail, fuhu, roserooftop, or all (default).

tools.name: get_blog_posts
tools.description: Get the latest news and blog posts from Zouk Group Las Vegas.

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific event by its event code, including performers, door times, venue address and ticket link.

eventcode.description: URvenue event code, e.g. "EVE60374500020260607". Obtain codes from get_upcoming_events.

tools.name: get_events_by_date
tools.description: Get events at Zouk Group Las Vegas venues on a specific date or date range.

date.description: Single date in YYYY-MM-DD format. For a range, use from_date and to_date instead.

venue.description: Venue slug to filter: zouk, ayu, redtail, fuhu, roserooftop. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_events_calendar
tools.description: Get the events calendar URL for Zouk Group Las Vegas.

tools.name: get_events_this_weekend
tools.description: Get events happening this Friday, Saturday and Sunday at Zouk Group Las Vegas venues.

venue.description: Venue slug to filter: zouk, ayu, redtail, fuhu, roserooftop. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_events_tonight
tools.description: Get events happening tonight at Zouk Group Las Vegas venues.

venue.description: Venue slug to filter: zouk, ayu, redtail, fuhu, roserooftop. Omit for all.

tools.name: get_faqs
tools.description: Get frequently asked questions about Zouk Group Las Vegas — sourced live from the website content. Covers dress code, age requirements, parking, VIP reservations and more.

tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Get the menu content for a Zouk Group Las Vegas dining venue (Fuhu or Famous Foods Street Eats), including dishes, descriptions and prices as published on the website.

tools.name: get_page_content
tools.description: Get the full text content of a specific Zouk Group website page by its URL slug.

slug.description: URL slug of the page, e.g. "about", "vip-tables", "private-events". Use get_site_pages to discover slugs.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Get general information about Zouk Group Las Vegas: name, address, events calendar URL, contact info, social links and a summary of all venues with hours, phone and dress code.

tools.name: get_site_pages
tools.description: List all published pages on the Zouk Group Las Vegas website with their URLs and slugs. Use this to discover what pages exist before fetching content.

tools.name: get_upcoming_events
tools.description: Get real upcoming events at Zouk Group Las Vegas venues from the live schedule. Returns event names, dates, times, performers, flyer images and ticket links.

venue.description: Venue slug to filter: zouk, ayu, moonbeam, redtail, fuhu, roserooftop, or all (default).

from_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today).

to_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: ~2 months from today).

tools.name: get_venue_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about Zouk Group Las Vegas venues — address, hours, phone, dress code, capacity and description. Optionally filter by venue slug.

venue.description: Venue slug to filter: zouk, ayu, fuhu, redtail, famousfoods. Omit for all venues.

tools.name: getCurrentPageSummary
tools.description: Returns title, canonical URL, meta description, and visible page text from the current page.

tools.name: getSiteAeoResources
tools.description: Returns public AEO discovery URLs for this website.

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search Zouk Group Las Vegas content — pages, news, venues, events and announcements.
